component.name: Tauon Music Box
component.summary: A powerful and streamlined music player for the desktop

description.p: Tauon Music Box is a modern, streamlined music player designed for the desktop with a fast, comfortable and responsive UI.

ul.li: Fast, comfortable and responsive UI with beautiful automatic theming.
Supports common codecs such as .FLAC and tracker file types such as .MOD.
Stream music from your PLEX, Jellyfin or Airsonic server.
Customisable UI with multiple widgets to choose from.
Shortcuts for searching artists on Rate Your Music and tracks on Genius.
Extract archives and import your music downloads in one click!
